description: Validates an already applied link-polarization compensation from complete H and D separable source-probe H/V/D/A/R/L tomography counts. It derives measured Stokes vectors plus H, D, and average polarization-direction agreement; it does not calculate state fidelity, acquire data, read a device, write a device, or install a compensation table.

linkId.description: Network-level identifier of the link whose already applied compensation is being validated.

countsBySourceProbeState.description: Complete, background-treated H and D separable source-probe count sets. Each probe must contain exactly H/V/D/A/R/L logical tomography counts.

minTotalCounts.description: Minimum sum of the six logical tomography counts required independently for each H or D source probe.

link.polarizationCompensation.observatio.description: Normalized H/D validation counts, measured Stokes vectors, and S0 values after the caller's compensation installation.

link.polarizationCompensation.estimate.s.description: Derived H, D, and average normalized-Stokes direction agreements for the supplied post-compensation H/D validation observations; this is not a state-fidelity metric.
